newsitem.title: USA: US Midco gasoline prices lure buyers off sidelines.
newsitem.headline: US Midco gasoline prices lure buyers off sidelines.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent unleaded gasoline basis firmed on Monday as bargain-hunting buyers were lured from the sidelines despite projections of high inventory levels in the region, traders said.
Unleaded differentials held onto early gains posted as sellers upped asking prices after buyers emerged in the spot market seeking January barrels early in the day, traders said.
"There's been some buyers out there seeking deals, but I just can't see basis moving all that much higher with all the gasoline we have in Williams," one trader said.
The Williams pipeline system feeding into the Group Three market had 25-days of gasoline supply and a huge 46-day supply of low-sulphur diesel on hand, a Group Three trader said.
Bids on unleaded gasoline were steady at 2.50 cents a gallon under NYMEX February unleaded in Group Three and 2.0 cents under the print in Chicago late in the day, traders said.
Traders attributed the firmess to buyers seeking out bargains in the spot market, although some suspected refiner buying was fueling the higher bids.
"There are some bottom-pickers out there," one Group Three trader said.
Low sulphur diesel was steady at 3.25/3.0 cents a gallon under NYMEX February heating oil in Group Three and 4.0/3.75 cents under the print in Chicago.
High sulphur diesel remained 8.25 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and 5.50 cents under the print in Chicago, traders said.
Jet/kero firmed to bids 3.0 cents a gallon under the print in Group Three and moved even with the print in Chicago.
